officialText:
The system ventilation efficiency (E v ) shall be determined using Table 403.3.1.1.2.3.2 or Appendix A of ASHRAE 62.1.

Table 403.3.1.1.2.3.2 System Ventilation Efficiency a, b

a. Max (Z p ) is the largest value of Z p calculated using Equation 4-5 among all the zones served by the system.

b. Interpolating between table values shall be permitted.
